metadata.title: मयूरभंज हैंडलूम साड़ी का इतिहास, वर्तमान, भविष्य । Main Bhi Bharat | Handloom ।With English Captions
metadata.description: Mayurbhanj in Odisha has a glorious history of weaving and natural dyeing processes. But with the passage of time and the lack of a favourable ecosystem, handloom has lost its charm here. The masters of this art lost interest in weaving and handlooms, as powerloom took over their market. But now, a few people are trying to revive this industry in Mayurbhanj. In this ground report, we explore the history, present, and try to find out what can be the future of this industry.
